text:
Maya Patel: :loudspeaker: Quick heads-up — we
re updating on-prem audit-log retention defaults for Private/VPC installs to 90 days (was 30). This helps customer e-discovery and incident forensics. Details below.

Noah Rivera: Is this a config change or a hard policy? Any storage impact?

Maya Patel: Default change only. Customers can opt for shorter/longer retention in installer flags. Westimate +25% storage for default workloads; telemetry will report actual usage per cluster.

Samir Kapoor: Do we need a migration job to backfill older logs for customers who want 90 days now?

Maya Patel: Optional backfill tool included in release: 
```
redwoodctl onprem audit-backfill --cluster ID --days 90
# runs a streaming backfill that respects rate limits
```

Elena Torres: Ops note: we added an admin dashboard tile for retention usage and an alert when projected growth > 40% in 7 days. Also added a warning in installer preflight.

Compliance Bot: Policy check: 90 days meets most EU/NA e-discovery needs. For customers requiring 7-year retention (enterprise), we
 dd a retention-archive option: encrypted cold storage + HSM key wrap. See appendix.

Noah Rivera: Action items?

Maya Patel: - Engineering: ship backfill tool + telemetry (Noah)
- Docs: update on-prem installer flags + FAQ (Elena)
- CS: customer advisory + opt-in migration guidance (Samir)

Samir Kapoor: Ian draft the advisory today. Will include opt-in steps and cost estimates.

Elena Torres: ETA for docs: EOD Monday. I1 post link here.

Maya Patel: Enforcement note: default installer will change on 2026-09-01 for new installs. Existing customers are not changed unless they opt-in or run backfill.

Noah Rivera: Noted. Will start on telemetry and backfill limits.

Maya Patel: Thanks team — ping #incidents if any customer-side issues during backfill. Closing announcement unless exec wants a wider comms.
